name: Rappi
body: A canonical, a 301 from http to https, and robots.txt listing sitemaps for its partners. But the viewport sets maximum-scale=1, which can block pinch-zoom for people who need bigger text.
lesson: Use width=device-width, initial-scale=1 and nothing more. Fix layout overflow instead of locking zoom.
summary: www.rappi.com.co scores 69 out of 100 (D). 5 checks fail now, 20 are at risk, and 21 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages read. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 38 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /bogota/restaurantes/delivery/2259-mcdonalds, /bogota/restaurantes/delivery/8642-kfc-pollo, /bogota/restaurantes/delivery/8481-el-corral-hamburguesa and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages read.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 3 cookies are sent without Secure, and 1 session cookie is readable by scripts
fix.evidence: Without Secure: guestAuthVersion, rappi.gema.location, currentLocation. Without HttpOnly: guestAuthVersion. A script injected into the page could steal the session. Set on /, /bogota/restaurantes/delivery/2259-mcdonalds,…
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: The viewport stops people from zooming
fix.evidence: The viewport tag sets user-scalable=no or maximum-scale=1.
fix.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag.

fix.title: 11 pages name another URL as canonical
fix.fix: Make each page's canonical point at itself unless it is a real duplicate.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 395 ms
Every page has a meta description
